name: Solid State System Co., Ltd.
summary: Solid State System Co., Ltd., together with its affiliated companies, focuses on the development, manufacturing, and marketing of semiconductor chips throughout Taiwan. The firm provides an array of solutions, including storage technologies like USB flash drive controllers and complete solid-state drive platforms. Additionally, its product portfolio features multimedia audio components, such as control chips for USB speakers, headsets, and line-in audio interfaces. The company also supplies micro-electro-mechanical systems (MEMS) microphones. Founded in 1998, Solid State System Co., Ltd. is based in Zhubei, Taiwan.
